title: Network Expansion: 1,500 cr once, accepted at Central Nexus, a visit to Node Alpha, handed in at Central Nexus
note: Architect line of the Central Nexus board, the link after First Steps in the Void: visit the Node Alpha system, return to Central Nexus; 1,500 cr once, voidborn mastery, exploration and navigation XP; nothing carried, nothing bought. Offered (boards read at 08:34 UTC) to the 6 of 8 traders docked at Central Nexus that have First Steps in the Void done, and to neither of the two that still have First Steps on their board (get_missions for each; voidborn mastery XP 15 in data/fleet/ships/ for the six). Test by hand, one trader, 08:35 to 08:43 UTC: accepted at Central Nexus, the visit counted on docking at Node Alpha, handed in at Central Nexus: RESULT +1,450 cr after fuel in 8 minutes (data/routes/runs.jsonl). The next link appears on the board after the hand-in: The Collective Provides (2,500 cr once, mine 20 nickel ore; no nickel field in home space). Open to every pilot that holds First Steps in the Void booked (requires.booked); max_ships 10: the stops are docks at our own stations and the board offers it to each pilot apart. 2026-11-16 09:06 UTC (fill.py, Mercury): max_ships 10 -> 20.
